title: Publish Log
description: Per-platform publish/export results produced by the Publisher agent.

engagement_cta.description: Comment-keyword call to action ("Comment GUIDE and I'll send you the checklist") when the video asks viewers to comment a word. Recorded so the overlay, caption and any comment-to-DM automation use the same word; recording it sends nothing.

keyword.description: The exact word viewers are asked to comment, as shown on screen.

promise.description: What commenters receive, e.g. 'the free checklist'.

caption_line.description: First caption line repeating the CTA, before the platform's 'more' cut.

dm_message.description: Draft direct message that delivers the promise, for whichever comment-to-DM automation the creator uses.

public_reply.description: Optional draft public reply under the comment.

platforms.description: Platforms where the CTA appears, e.g. ['instagram_reels', 'tiktok'].
